target.definition: Total number of passengers passing through London Heathrow Airport during the calendar month of September 2026, as reported in Heathrow's monthly traffic statistics.

inputs.name: annual_passengers_2025
inputs.description: Total passengers at Heathrow in the full year 2025.

provenance.rationale: Heathrow handled about 79–84 million passengers in recent years; 84 million is a plausible 2025 level.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual passengers that travel in September.

provenance.rationale: September is a busy month but not peak summer; roughly 8–9% of annual traffic.

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor
inputs.description: Growth factor from 2025 to 2026 for Heathrow passenger traffic.

provenance.rationale: Heathrow traffic has been recovering; modest growth or slight decline is plausible.

inputs.name: daily_passengers
inputs.description: Average number of passengers per day at Heathrow in September.

provenance.rationale: Heathrow handles roughly 200,000–250,000 passengers per day in busy months.

inputs.name: annual_capacity
inputs.description: Practical annual passenger capacity of Heathrow Airport.

provenance.rationale: Heathrow's two runways have a practical capacity around 80 million passengers per year.

inputs.name: capacity_utilization
inputs.description: Average utilization of annual capacity in September.

provenance.rationale: September is a busy month; utilization is likely high but not necessarily 100%.

inputs.name: uk_annual_air_passengers
inputs.description: Total passengers at all UK airports in a year.

provenance.rationale: UK airports handle roughly 250–290 million passengers per year.

inputs.name: heathrow_share_of_uk
inputs.description: Heathrow's share of total UK air passengers.

provenance.rationale: Heathrow is the largest UK airport, typically handling about 30% of UK passengers.

paths.description: Estimate annual passengers for 2026 and allocate the September share.
Count daily passengers and multiply by days in September.
Scale from UK total air passengers using Heathrow's share, then allocate September share.
